excerpts: No. 12 BYU beats Kansas 31-29 in 3 overtimes to stay alive in the College Football Playoff race By AP Updated: Nov 21, 2026, 04:47 pm Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email LAWRENCE, Kan. -- — [Bear Bachmeier](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5141367/bear-bachmeier) threw for 173 yards, ran for a pair of touchdowns and connected with [Jojo Phillips](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5160955/jojo-phillips) in the back of the end zone in the third overtime, helping No. 12 BYU beat Kansas 31-29 on Saturday and keep its College Football Playoff hopes alive. [LJ Martin](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/4918126/lj-martin) added 127 yards rushing with a touchdown in the second overtime, and the Cougars (9-2, 6-2 Big 12, No. 10 CFP) were able to narrowly avoid a catastrophic loss by beating the Jayhawks (4-7, 2-7) for the first time in four attempts. “Those guys gave us a tough game, and they’re such a better team than what their record shows,” BYU coach Kalani Sitake said. “I thought we might have had the game under control at some moments, and they just kept fighting back.” [Isaiah Marshall](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5079604/isaiah-marshall) had 186 yards passing and two touchdowns for Kansas, along with 90 yards rushing and another score.
